summary: The registrant, Change Agents Corporation (formerly Avalon GloboCare), filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of $616,000 aggregate principal amount of 7% OID promissory notes (with $66,000 OID) to accredited investors for $550,000 gross proceeds, plus pre-funded warrants to purchase 1,000,000 common shares at $0.0001 per share as an inducement. Proceeds repay existing debt and fund working capital. The notes mature May 14, 2027, are prepayable at 105%, and include negative covenants and a most-favored-nations provision. This is a routine financing transaction, not a special situation; no change of control, strategic review, or shareholder-approval event beyond standard Nasdaq limitations.
